briefing: Markets were flat and directionless today (NASDAQ +0.0%, S&P 500 -0.1%), giving no clear risk-on signal. With only $89.29 in cash — well under the $500 deployment threshold — and no compelling reason to force a trade, we held all 7 existing positions and skipped new buys.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash held in reserve, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today our cash balance was below the threshold needed to open a new position, and the market gave no strong risk-on signal, so the disciplined move was to hold that cash rather than force a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是留存備用、等待良機出手的現金。今日我們的現金餘額低於開新倉所需的門檻，市場也沒有明確的風險偏好訊號，因此紀律性的做法是保留現金，而非勉強進行交易。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially flat today, with the S&P 500 slipping slightly and the NASDAQ unchanged, reflecting a lack of strong catalysts on either side. Without clear directional conviction, institutional flows stayed muted rather than pushing decisively into risk assets or defensive positions. This kind of low-volatility, range-bound session is common in the absence of major economic data or earnings surprises.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢大致持平，標普500指數微跌，納斯達克指數則幾乎持平，反映市場缺乏明確的推動因素。在方向不明朗的情況下，機構資金並未大幅流入風險資產或防禦性板塊。這種低波動、區間震盪的走勢，通常出現在缺乏重大經濟數據或財報驚喜的時候。
